Hds::Button.description: Primary button component with various styles and sizes

@text.notes: Text content moves from @text attribute to default slot

@color.notes: HDS Button @color only accepts 'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary' — there is no 'critical' value on Button (use Hds::Alert or a different pattern for danger actions). Maps directly to the kind attribute on cds-button.

@isInline.notes: @isInline renders the button inline (no block display). cds-button has no inline mode — remove this attribute and adjust layout via CSS if needed.

@icon.notes: Icon moves to named slot — must be substituted with the correct Carbon SVG. No automatic string-to-import mapping exists.

@isIconOnly.notes: When @isIconOnly is true, use cds-icon-button instead of cds-button. Place the Carbon SVG in slot='icon' and provide a tooltip label via label. Example: Edit. Remove the @isIconOnly attribute itself after switching the tag.

@href.notes: When @href is present, HDS Button renders as an <a>. cds-button also renders as <a> when href is set.

@isHrefExternal.notes: @isHrefExternal={{true}} becomes target='_blank'. Only relevant when @href is also present.

Hds::Button.notes: High confidence for standard text buttons. @isIconOnly requires a component tag change to cds-icon-button. @icon/@iconPosition require manual Carbon SVG substitution. @href/@isHrefExternal are link-mode args that pass through. @isInline has no Carbon equivalent and must be dropped.

@type.notes: @type is the Helios display VARIANT ('page-level', 'inline', 'compact') — not the severity. Choose the correct CWC tag based on this value: 'page-level' → cds-actionable-notification, 'inline' → cds-inline-notification, 'compact' → cds-inline-notification (no direct compact equivalent, use low-contrast mode). Do NOT map @type to kind.

@color.notes: @color is the Helios severity — maps to kind on the CWC notification. 'neutral' and 'highlight' both map to 'info' (Carbon has no separate highlight kind).

@icon.notes: @icon overrides the default severity icon, or @icon={{false}} hides it. Carbon notifications always show a status icon matching the kind — there is no icon override. If @icon={{false}}, there is no direct equivalent; the icon cannot be hidden on cds-inline-notification.

@onDismiss.notes: cds-inline-notification includes a dismiss (close) button by default — no extra button needed. If @onDismiss is present, wire the built-in cds-notification-closed DOM event ({{on 'cds-notification-closed' this.onDismiss}}) to replace the Helios @onDismiss arg. If no dismiss button is desired at all, add the hide-close-button boolean attribute to suppress it.

Title.notes: HdsAlert uses contextual components: <HdsAlert as |A|><A.Title>text</A.Title></HdsAlert>. The A.Title content becomes the title slot or title attribute on the CWC notification.

Description.notes: A.Description content becomes the subtitle slot or subtitle attribute. If multiple A.Description blocks are used, concatenate them.

Button.notes: A.Button (a bound HdsButton) has no equivalent on cds-inline-notification. If an action button is needed, switch to cds-actionable-notification and use the action-button-label attribute for the button label.

LinkStandalone.notes: A.LinkStandalone has no equivalent on Carbon notifications. If a link action is needed inside an alert, switch to cds-actionable-notification or place the link outside the notification.

GenericContent.notes: A.GenericContent allows arbitrary content inside the alert. cds-inline-notification only supports title/subtitle text — use cds-actionable-notification with a custom slot if rich content is required.

GenericFooter.notes: A.GenericFooter has no Carbon equivalent. Use cds-actionable-notification with its action slot for footer-level interactions.

Hds::Alert.notes: Medium confidence. HdsAlert uses contextual components (as |A| pattern). The correct CWC tag depends on @type: 'inline'/'compact' → cds-inline-notification, 'page-level' → cds-actionable-notification. Severity (@color → kind) maps cleanly. Dismissal is built-in on CWC. A.Button, A.LinkStandalone, A.GenericContent, A.GenericFooter have no inline-notification equivalents — these cases require cds-actionable-notification or manual restructuring.

Hds::Dropdown.description: Dropdown select component — presents a list of options from which a user can select one. Maps to cds-dropdown with cds-dropdown-item children.

@isOpen.notes: @isOpen={{true}} maps to the open boolean attribute on cds-dropdown.

@enableCollisionDetection.notes: @enableCollisionDetection maps to the autoalign boolean attribute on cds-dropdown.

@selected.notes: The selected value maps to the value attribute on cds-dropdown.

@label.notes: Placeholder/label text for the closed state of the dropdown.

cds-dropdown-selected.notes: Fires after a dropdown item is selected. event.detail.item.value gives the selected value.

cds-dropdown-toggled.notes: Fires after the open state is toggled.

default.notes: Each selectable option becomes a <cds-dropdown-item value='...'> child of cds-dropdown. The item text becomes the default slot content of cds-dropdown-item.

Hds::Dropdown.notes: Medium-high confidence for standard select-style dropdowns. Replace <HdsDropdown> with <cds-dropdown title-text='Label'>. Each option becomes <cds-dropdown-item value='val'>Label</cds-dropdown-item>. @enableCollisionDetection → autoalign. @isOpen → open. @isInline → type='inline'. Listen for cds-dropdown-selected for selection changes.

Hds::Form::TextInput::Field.description: Text input field with label, helper text, and error message

@type.notes: HDS accepts: text, email, password, url, date, time, datetime-local, search, month, week, tel. All map directly to the HTML input type attribute on cds-text-input.

@isOptional.notes: @isOptional shows an '(Optional)' label hint in HDS. cds-text-input has no equivalent — remove and handle optional labelling in the label text directly.

@isInvalid.notes: Direct @isInvalid → invalid attr swap. If the invalid state is driven by a conditional block ({{#if}}<Field.Error>) rather than a direct @isInvalid attr, set invalid={{condition}} directly on cds-text-input.

@isLoading.notes: @isLoading shows a loading spinner inside the input. cds-text-input has no equivalent loading state — remove and handle loading state at the form level if needed.

@hasVisibilityToggle.notes: @hasVisibilityToggle adds a show/hide toggle for password fields. cds-text-input has no built-in visibility toggle — implement manually with a cds-icon-button adjacent to the input.

@width.notes: @width sets a custom CSS width on the input. Apply width via CSS on cds-text-input or a wrapper element instead.

@extraAriaDescribedBy.notes: Additional aria-describedby IDs. Map directly to aria-describedby on cds-text-input, combining with any existing IDs.

Label.notes: text can be migrated to either: (a) the label-text named slot (text) to preserve rich content, or (b) the label attribute (label="text") for plain text. Prefer the slot when the label content is anything other than a plain string.

HelperText.notes: text can be migrated to either: (a) the helper-text named slot (text) to preserve rich content, or (b) the helper-text attribute for plain text. Prefer the slot when the helper content is anything other than a plain string.

Error.notes: text can be migrated to either: (a) the validity-message named slot (text) to preserve rich content, or (b) the invalid-text attribute for plain text. The {{#if}} condition controlling it becomes the invalid boolean attribute on cds-text-input.

CharacterCount.notes: <Field.CharacterCount> renders a character count helper below the input. cds-text-input has no built-in character count slot — implement manually using cds-form-item with a character count display, or use a cds-text-area if character count is a hard requirement.

Hds::Form::TextInput::Field.notes: Medium-high confidence for standard usages (value, type, label, helper, error). @isOptional, @isLoading, @hasVisibilityToggle, and @width require manual handling — no direct CWC equivalents. CharacterCount slot requires manual implementation. Field.Label/HelperText/Error can use either named slots (for rich content) or flat attributes (for plain text).

default.notes: All children (cds-button elements) pass through unchanged as direct children of cds-button-set

Hds::ButtonSet.notes: Carbon has a direct equivalent: cds-button-set. Replace <HdsButtonSet> with <cds-button-set> and place cds-button children inside it. Example: <cds-button-set><cds-button kind='secondary'>Cancel</cds-button><cds-button kind='primary'>Save</cds-button></cds-button-set>. If inside a cds-modal-footer, use cds-modal-footer-button instead and omit the cds-button-set wrapper.

Hds::Accordion.description: Accordion component for collapsible content sections

@size.notes: HDS Accordion @size maps to size on cds-accordion-item. Apply to each cds-accordion-item individually.

@type.notes: HDS @type controls the visual style of the accordion (e.g. 'card', 'flush'). cds-accordion has no direct type equivalent — the default flush style is closest to HDS default. Remove and verify visually.

@forceState.notes: HDS @forceState forces all accordion items open or closed. cds-accordion has no equivalent — control the open attribute on each cds-accordion-item individually.

@titleTag.notes: HDS @titleTag controls the heading element rendered for the toggle. cds-accordion-item manages its own heading semantics — remove this arg.

Item.notes: A.Item contextual component (yielded as <A.Item>) becomes <cds-accordion-item>. @isOpen={{true}} becomes the open boolean attribute on cds-accordion-item. @title becomes the title attribute.

toggle.notes: Inside A.Item, the <:toggle>text</:toggle> named block becomes title='text' attribute on cds-accordion-item.

content.notes: Inside A.Item, the <:content>...</:content> named block becomes direct children of cds-accordion-item.

Hds::Accordion.notes: Medium confidence. @size maps directly. @type and @forceState have no Carbon equivalent and require manual handling. @titleTag is dropped. The A.Item contextual component structure (with :toggle/:content named blocks) maps cleanly to cds-accordion-item with title attribute + direct children. Verify visual fidelity for @type values other than default.

@size.notes: HDS @size ('small', 'medium', 'large') maps to size attribute on cds-modal.

@color.notes: HDS @color sets the modal header color ('neutral', 'warning', 'critical'). cds-modal has no color attribute — remove. If danger styling is needed, use cds-modal with kind='danger' (if available in your CWC version).

@isDismissDisabled.notes: @isDismissDisabled prevents closing the modal via Escape or the close button. On cds-modal, add prevent-close-on-click-outside and handle the cds-modal-beingclosed event, calling event.preventDefault() to block dismissal.

@onOpen.notes: No cds-modal-opened event exists. Use the open attribute watcher or a Glimmer modifier to detect when the modal opens.

@onClose.notes: Helios uses an @onClose arg; Carbon fires a cds-modal-closed DOM event — wire via {{on 'cds-modal-closed' this.closeModal}} instead.

@returnFocusTo.notes: @returnFocusTo sets the element to restore focus to on close. cds-modal manages focus return automatically — remove unless a specific non-default element needs focus, in which case handle it manually in the cds-modal-closed event handler.

cds-modal-beingclosed.notes: Fires before close. Call event.preventDefault() to block dismissal (replaces @isDismissDisabled).

Header.notes: M.Header contextual component becomes <cds-modal-header><cds-modal-heading>text</cds-modal-heading></cds-modal-header>. M.Header also yields @onDismiss — in Carbon the close button is built into cds-modal-header automatically.

Footer.notes: M.Footer yields MF.close — replace {{on 'click' MF.close}} with data-modal-close attribute on the button. Use cds-modal-footer-button for footer buttons.

openPattern.notes: Remove the {{#if}} block — use the open attribute directly on cds-modal instead.

Hds::Modal.notes: Medium confidence. @size maps directly. @color, @isDismissDisabled, @onOpen, @returnFocusTo all require manual handling. @onClose becomes a cds-modal-closed event listener. Contextual slots (M.Header/Body/Footer) become explicit child elements. The open/close pattern differs: Helios uses {{#if}} + @onClose; Carbon uses open attribute + cds-modal-closed event + data-modal-close on buttons.

Hds::AppFrame.description: Application layout wrapper providing header and sidebar slots. No CWC equivalent — layout is handled by CSS and the cds-header/cds-side-nav positioning rules.

@hasHeader.notes: No equivalent on CWC. The presence of cds-header in the DOM implicitly creates the header region. Remove this attribute.

@hasSidebar.notes: No equivalent on CWC. The presence of cds-side-nav in the DOM implicitly creates the sidebar region. Remove this attribute.

Header.notes: Frame.Header slot content becomes a standalone cds-header element at the top of the page.

Sidebar.notes: Frame.Sidebar slot content becomes a standalone cds-side-nav element.

Main.notes: Frame.Main slot content becomes a <main class="cds--content"> element.

Hds::AppFrame.notes: No CWC component equivalent. HdsAppFrame is a layout shell that yields Header/Sidebar/Main named slots. In CWC, this layout is achieved by placing cds-header, cds-side-nav, and <main class="cds--content"> as sibling elements. The CSS rule cds-header ~ cds-side-nav { block-size: calc(100% - 3rem); margin-block-start: 3rem } handles the header-offset positioning. Remove HdsAppFrame entirely and restructure the template.

Hds::AppHeader.description: Top application header bar with logo, navigation, and utility action slots.

@hasA11yRefocus.notes: CWC has no equivalent a11y refocus prop. Remove this attribute. cds-header handles focus management internally.

logo.notes: The :logo named slot content (HdsAppHeaderHomeLink) becomes cds-header-name inside cds-header.

globalActions.notes: The :globalActions slot (org switcher dropdown) becomes a cds-header-global-action with panel-id wired to a cds-header-panel containing a cds-switcher.

utilityActions.notes: Each utility action (search, help, user) becomes a cds-header-global-action inside a div.cds--header__global wrapper inside cds-header.

Hds::AppHeader.notes: Medium confidence. The overall structure maps to cds-header but the named slots (:logo, :globalActions, :utilityActions) have no direct CWC equivalents — each must be manually restructured. The :logo slot becomes cds-header-name. Utility icon actions (search, user, help) become cds-header-global-action elements inside div.cds--header__global. The org switcher in :globalActions maps to a cds-header-global-action triggering a cds-header-panel with a cds-switcher.

Hds::AppHeader::HomeLink.description: Home/logo link inside the app header.

@icon.notes: HDS renders a Flight icon by name (e.g. @icon="hashicorp"). cds-header-name has no icon slot — place a Carbon SVG or an as a child element before the platform name text if a logo image is needed.

@text.notes: @text becomes the text content inside cds-header-name, typically after an optional prefix. Example: <cds-header-name href=/ prefix=HashiCorp>Cloud</cds-header-name>.

Hds::AppHeader::HomeLink.notes: Medium-high confidence. @href and @text map cleanly. @icon has no slot equivalent on cds-header-name — if a logo SVG/image is needed, place it as a child element. The prefix attribute on cds-header-name can be used for a product family name prefix (e.g. prefix="IBM").

Hds::AppSideNav.description: Application side navigation panel, optionally collapsible and responsive.

@isResponsive.notes: @isResponsive={{true}} maps to collapse-mode="responsive" on cds-side-nav. When false, use collapse-mode="fixed".

@isCollapsible.notes: @isCollapsible enables the hamburger toggle. In CWC this is achieved by adding a cds-header-menu-button inside cds-header (not on cds-side-nav itself). The toggle wiring between cds-header-menu-button and cds-side-nav is handled automatically by CWC when they are siblings inside cds-header.

@isMinimized.notes: @isMinimized={{true}} maps to the absence of the expanded attribute on cds-side-nav (i.e. collapsed state). @isMinimized={{false}} → add expanded attribute.

onToggle.notes: The toggle event is emitted by cds-header-menu-button, not cds-side-nav itself.

default.notes: The default slot content (HdsAppSideNavList instances) must be wrapped in a cds-side-nav-items element.

Hds::AppSideNav.notes: Medium confidence. The collapse/responsive behaviour maps reasonably well. Key difference: the hamburger toggle button is a separate cds-header-menu-button inside cds-header — not a prop on cds-side-nav. The aria-label must be added directly to cds-side-nav. Slot content must be wrapped in cds-side-nav-items.

Hds::AppSideNav::List.description: A grouped list of navigation links inside the side nav.

aria-label.notes: aria-label passes through directly to cds-side-nav-items.

SNL.Title.notes: HDS SNL.Title renders a visible section label above nav links. cds-side-nav-items has no title/label sub-component — use a cds-side-nav-menu with the title attribute as the nearest equivalent for grouped sections, or omit the label entirely.

SNL.Link.notes: Each SNL.Link becomes a cds-side-nav-link. @text becomes text content (default slot). @href passes through. @icon SVG must be placed in slot="title-icon". @isActive maps to the active attribute. @badge has no CWC equivalent and must be dropped or implemented via custom markup.

Hds::AppSideNav::List.notes: Low-medium confidence. The list container maps to cds-side-nav-items but the contextual sub-components differ significantly. SNL.Title has no CWC equivalent — the closest is using cds-side-nav-menu as a collapsible group header. SNL.Link maps to cds-side-nav-link but @icon requires inlining a Carbon SVG in slot="title-icon" (no string-based icon name). @badge is unsupported in CWC side nav and must be dropped. @isActive maps to the active boolean attribute.

Hds::Text::Body.description: Body text component. No CWC custom element — transforms to a native HTML element with the Carbon body type class cds--body-01.

@tag.notes: Use the @tag value as the HTML element (p, div, span). Default to div when the content contains block-level children (ul, ol, p). Default to p when content is inline text only.

default.notes: Inner content passes through unchanged as children of the replacement element.

Hds::Text::Body.notes:
No CWC custom element. Replace ... with
...
(or

for inline-only content). The cds--body-01 class is provided by themes.css and applies Carbon body typography (IBM Plex Sans, 14px, 1.4 line-height). Remove HdsTextBody import after migration.

Hds::Form.description: Form container component. Maps to cds-form which provides Carbon form layout and spacing.

as |F|.notes: Block param syntax (as |F|) is Glimmer-specific. Remove entirely — cds-form has no contextual components.

F.Section.notes: F.Section contextual component becomes a plain <div class="cds--form-item"> or <fieldset> as a direct child of cds-form.

F.Footer.notes: F.Footer contextual component becomes a plain <div class="cds--form-actions"> or similar wrapper. FF.ButtonSet inside becomes a cds-button-set.

Hds::Form.notes: Medium-high confidence. Replace <HdsForm as |F|> with <cds-form>. F.Section → plain <div> children. F.Footer as |FF| → plain <div>; FF.ButtonSet → cds-button-set. Remove HdsForm import after migration.

Hds::PageHeader.description: Page-level title and description header. No CWC equivalent (deprecated). Transforms to native HTML heading + body paragraph with Carbon type classes.

as |PH|.notes: Block param syntax is Glimmer-specific. Remove entirely.

PH.Title.notes: PH.Title content becomes an <h1 class="cds--heading-03"> (or h2/h3 depending on page hierarchy).

Hds::PageHeader.notes:
No CWC custom element — CWC PageHeader is deprecated (moved to @carbon/ibm-products-web-components). Replace textdesc with

text

desc

. Remove HdsPageHeader import after migration.

Hds::AppFooter.description: Global page footer. No CWC equivalent in @carbon/web-components — transforms to a native HTML <footer> element styled with Carbon design tokens.

as |AF|.notes: Block param syntax is Glimmer-specific. Remove entirely — the plain HTML footer has no contextual components.

AF.StatusLink.notes: @status='operational' → render a status dot span + 'All systems operational' text. Use a colored dot via CSS (background: var(--cds-support-success)) to indicate status.

AF.Link.notes: Each AF.Link becomes a native <a> element inside <nav class='carbon-demo-footer-links'>. @href passes through. @icon/@iconPosition are dropped.

AF.LegalLinks.notes: Replace with <nav class='carbon-demo-footer-legal'> containing plain <a> elements for Terms, Privacy, Security, Cookies.

AF.Copyright.notes: AF.Copyright renders a copyright notice. Replace with a plain <span> containing the copyright text.

Hds::AppFooter.notes: No CWC custom element. Replace <HdsAppFooter> with a plain <footer class='carbon-demo-footer'> styled with Carbon tokens. AF.StatusLink → status dot + text. AF.Link → <a> in a <nav>. AF.LegalLinks → <nav> with standard legal links. See carbon-demo.css for .carbon-demo-footer styles.

Hds::Badge.description: Badge/tag component for labels and status indicators

@text.notes: @text becomes the default slot content of cds-tag.

@type.notes: HDS @type (filled/inverted/outlined) maps to the type attribute on cds-tag.

@color.notes: HDS @color maps to the type attribute on cds-tag. Note: @type and @color both target type — @color takes precedence for semantic meaning.

@isInteractive.notes: @isInteractive makes the badge clickable. Use cds-interactive-tag instead of cds-tag when this prop is present.

default.notes: Default slot content passes through unchanged as children of cds-tag.

Hds::Badge.notes: Medium-high confidence. HdsBadge maps to cds-tag. @text → default slot. @color maps to type attribute (neutral → gray, highlight → purple, success → green, warning → yellow, critical → red). @type maps to type (filled/inverted→high-contrast/outlined). @size maps directly. If @isInteractive is present, use cds-interactive-tag instead.
